lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Halo's hand-built. Draws a picture of the room's signal on the ceiling. It does nothing useful and it is the best thing anyone in here has made.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Half this bar works at Meridian and the other half wishes it did. Ask either half what they are building and you will get a different answer and both of them mean it.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: There is a vote Thursday about publishing the weights. Everyone in here is for it and none of us has a vote, which is the whole of engineering in one sentence.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: It is in the papers. All nine pages. This bar has not been this loud since it was a machine shop.
